content:
Apple has rolled out several new software updates today, including tvOS 26.6, HomePod 26.6, visionOS 26.6, and more.

tvOS 26.6, HomePod 26.6, and visionOS 26.6 are now rolling out to users

Apple has just released a new round of software updates across its entire product lineup.

This round of updates includes tvOS 26.6, HomePod 26.6, visionOS 26.6, as well as iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6, among other highly anticipated versions.

According to Apple's official release notes, this update focuses on "performance and stability improvements," while also including some security patches.

Overall, this batch of updates should make your Apple TV 4K, HomePod, and Vision Pro run more smoothly than before. However, beyond underlying improvements, no new features have been added in this update.

The reason is that we are about to welcome the fall releases of tvOS 27, HomePod 27, and visionOS 27.

The aforementioned new operating systems and their features were unveiled in June and are currently in beta testing, with an official release expected in September.

A heads-up: tvOS 27 will no longer support two popular Apple TV models. If your device is not on the compatibility list, you'll be stuck on tvOS 26.6 and subsequent minor updates.

Have you discovered any new features in tvOS 26.6 or other updates? Let us know in the comments.

Featured Apple TV 4K and smart home accessories

  • AirPods Pro 3 (reduced from $249 to $199)
  • Non-slip silicone protective case for Siri Remote, compatible with AirTag
  • TotalMount Apple TV mount
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • eufy 4K camera with HomeKit Secure Video support
